title: Ordinary completed finite reduction and tensor with the quotient complex
statement: Let T, A and d be the completed coefficient datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and let n be a natural number. Ordinary scalar extension along the actual completed-ring projection to A/I^(n+1), followed by restriction, is additive. Tensor with that quotient module placed in degree zero, followed by localization, is naturally isomorphic on all cochain complexes to termwise ordinary reduction followed by localization. The total tensor is the functor recorded in [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-tensor-products]; it is used here before derivation, without a perfectness hypothesis on the degree-zero quotient.

source.place: tensoring with the bounded finite-projective representative: ordinary quotient tensor comparison

proof.text: Use [lem-pur-change-of-rings-tensor-cancellation] with the quotient unit module. Compose with the inverse left unitor and the specified object identifications of the chosen ordinary extension functor. The chosen map formula, left-unitor naturality and cancellation naturality make these components a natural isomorphism from ordinary extension/restriction to tensor with the quotient on the left.

Symmetry gives the ordinary comparison with tensor on the right. The existing CochainComplex.map₂HomologicalComplexFlipObjSingleIso identifies total tensor with a degree-zero factor with termwise tensor. Compose it with NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex of the ordinary comparison and postcompose with localization. Both ordinary extension and restriction are additive, so the comparison applies to all complexes, including unbounded ones.

theorem completedReductionOrdinaryTensorComparison (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ h : (adicDatumOrdinaryReduction T d n).Additive,

        ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor (adicDatumModules T d) 0).obj
          (CompletedConstantReduction.residue T d.ideal n)) ≅
        completedConstantMapComplex (adicDatumOrdinaryReduction T d n) h ⋙
